title: Evals as CI & Observability
summary: LLM apps need evaluation suites that run like CI: curated cases, graders, regression thresholds, and production tracing. Without evals, prompt and model changes are flying blind.

sections.title: Offline evals
paragraphs: Gold sets with expected behaviors; LLM-as-judge with caution; deterministic checkers for structured outputs. Split by capability (retrieval, tool use, safety).

sections.title: Online evaluation
paragraphs: Sample production traces, score asynchronously, watch for drift. User feedback is sparse — instrument explicit signals.

sections.title: CI integration
paragraphs: Block deploys on eval regressions. Version prompts, models, and retrievers together. Keep eval costs bounded with sampling strata.

sections.title: Observability
paragraphs: Trace prompts, tool calls, retrieved chunks, token costs, and latency. You cannot fix what you cannot attribute.

deepDive.title: Evals as CI & Observability — Operations
paragraphs: Operating Evals as CI & Observability in production means defining SLIs before tuning knobs, knowing amplification costs, and rehearsing failure modes.
Prefer reversible changes, feature flags, and canaries. Measure p50/p99 and error rate under load that matches production skew.
bullets: Define capacity from the scarcest resource
Keep rollback cheaper than forward repair when possible

deepDive.title: Evals as CI & Observability — Failure modes
paragraphs: Common failures around Evals as CI & Observability include overload, partial dependency outages, and silent correctness bugs that pass happy-path tests.
Inject faults in staging: latency, loss, clock skew, and disk full. Verify alerts fire and degradation is intentional.

expert.title: Evals as CI & Observability — Expert notes
paragraphs: At the expert level, Evals as CI & Observability intersects multi-region consistency, cost envelopes, and organizational constraints (team ownership, on-call load).
Write down the non-goals. Many outages come from optimizing a metric that was never the product requirement.

keyTakeaways: Evals are the unit tests of AI systems
whyItMatters: AI features change behavior without compile errors; evals are how you keep control.
reflectionQuestions: What eval would have caught your last AI regression?
numbersToKnow: Know your p99 latency budget before adding hops
Peak load ≠ average load — plan headroom (often 2–3×)
Cross-region RTT is often ~50–150ms one way
